_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL — no frozen family API contract exists (see lib/api-client/family.ts)
_provenance.note: Display-level family snapshot. THE HOUSEHOLD SHAPE (captain, 2026-09-30): one account (the manager `family`) holds MANY loved ones, and `loved_ones[]` keys the same records the pages always read — name, life dates, plan, balance, payment schedule and papers — per person. `balance_cents` mirrors the display strings as integer minor units so views never parse a display price (repo money rule); tests/fixture-contract/family.test.ts pins that the two agree per loved one. `recent_documents[].kind` is the family-safe classification (service_contract / official_receipt / other): the first two are the family's own papers, the portal never asks them to request those, and `lib/api-client/family.ts::toFamilyDocument` drops every field a document record carries beyond title/status/kind/reference/issued_on/amount/covers. Each recorded official receipt is the family's copy of an instalment the payment_schedule records as paid — the amount is the recorded instalment's own, never a new figure — so the Papers popup can open a real sheet (HTML + the guarded PDF route). Their numbers are recorded fixture values in the family portal's own receipt namespace; when the payments/AR projection freezes they are replaced by the service's receipts. `payment_schedule` is each loved one's own plan instalments (client minute 2026-09-21, item 1): it records the payment mode, the first due date and each instalment's amount/paid in integer minor units; `lib/payment-schedule.ts` DERIVES every due date and the due-soon/overdue state, and the two-days-before notice. The dates are recorded data and age with the clock exactly like the billing seed; tests pin the boundary with explicit clocks so they never rot. Every loved one's record keeps this provisional marker; nothing here is a live record.
_provenance.household_note: TWO loved ones (Ernesto and Aurora Dela Cruz) so the household feature is visible end to end. They are APP-AUTHORED demo records in the same provisional spirit as lib/fixtures/family/workspace.json: the manager Cory Customer holds both, each plan/payment/papers record is internally consistent (schedule installments sum to its own balance_cents, next_due equals the first open installment's derived label) and grounded in the client's own recorded 2026 sheets, and no figure is invented beyond the office's own data.
